sources.snippet: Qwen3.6 35B A3B is an open-weight Qwen model designed particularly for coding agents, repository-scale reasoning and workflows that combine reasoning with tools. Alibaba describes Qwen3.6 as an evolution of Qwen3.5 focused on stability and practical coding utility.
